key_phrases: solve problems in other application domains
statistics emphasizes quantitative data and description
Andrew Gelman of Columbia University has described statistics as a non-essential part of data science
evidence_sentences: Data science is an interdisciplinary academic field that uses statistics, scientific computing, scientific methods, processing, scientific visualization, algorithms and systems to extract or extrapolate knowledge from potentially noisy, structured, or unstructured data.
Data science also integrates domain knowledge from the underlying application domain (e.g., natural sciences, information technology, and medicine).
A data scientist is a professional who creates programming code and combines it with statistical knowledge to summarize data.
